annotations.title: Edit a media item’s title, caption or description

description: Changes one media library item’s words; only the fields you send change. Take the id from search-media, which also shows what is there now. Each field replaces what is stored, and an empty string clears a caption or description. ⛔ It can’t replace the file or delete the item, and alt text stays with describe-image. Limited to 30 media writes an hour for each connection.

caption.description: The new caption. Scripts and event handlers are refused.

description.description: The new description. Scripts and event handlers are refused.

title.description: The new title. Can’t be blank.

name: agentimus-update-media

height.description: 0 when unknown or not an image.

id.description: The attachment id: featured_image takes this.

note.description: Not empty when what is stored differs from what was sent.

url.description: The file’s public address, ready to use in a post body.

width.description: 0 when unknown or not an image.
